title: Lipschitz regularity for fractional $p$-Laplacian with coercive gradients
summary: In this article we study nonlinear nonlocal equations with coercive gradient nonlinearity of the form \[ (-Δ_{p})^{s}u(x)+H(x,\nabla u)=f , \] where $f$ is Lipschitz continuous and the Hamiltonian $H$ satisfies the coercivity condition \[ H(x,ξ)\;\geq\;θ|ξ|^{m}-θ_{1} \qquad\text{for all } x,ξ\in\mathbb{R}^n, \] for some constants $θ,θ_{1}>0$ and $m>1$.
